question_text: Compare the average head_count at KeynoteHall_Stage between the morning keynote window 09:00-10:00 UTC and the afternoon keynote window 14:00-15:00 UTC on 2025-12-08. Which keynote had higher attendance and what were the approximate average head_counts?
answer_text: At camera_location "KeynoteHall_Stage" on 2025-12-08, the morning keynote (hour_utc 09:00–10:00 UTC) had higher attendance than the afternoon (hour_utc 14:00–15:00 UTC): average head_counts were 450.19 vs 399.51.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.camera_location = 'KeynoteHall_Stage'
    AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T09:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T10:00:00Z'
  RETURN coalesce(sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) / toFloat(sum(ch.event_count)), 0.0) AS morning_avg_hc
}
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.camera_location = 'KeynoteHall_Stage'
    AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T14:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T15:00:00Z'
  RETURN coalesce(sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) / toFloat(sum(ch.event_count)), 0.0) AS afternoon_avg_hc
}
RETURN
  'KeynoteHall_Stage' AS location,
  morning_avg_hc,
  afternoon_avg_hc,
  CASE
    WHEN morning_avg_hc > afternoon_avg_hc THEN 'morning'
    WHEN afternoon_avg_hc > morning_avg_hc THEN 'afternoon'
    ELSE 'tie'
  END AS higher_attendance
